title: 江雪
author: 柳宗元
intro: A thousand mountains without a bird, ten thousand paths without a footprint — and in the middle of the snow, one old man fishing alone. Twenty characters that paint total stillness.
analysis: 这首诗像一幅黑白山水画。前两句画背景：千座山上没有一只鸟在飞，万条小路上看不到一个人的脚印——世界大得空荡荡，冷得静悄悄。后两句画人物：江上一条小船，船上一个穿蓑衣、戴斗笠的老人，一个人在大雪里钓鱼。“千山”“万径”是大，“孤舟”“独钓”是小，一大一小，对比特别强烈，越显得老人孤单。可他并不慌张，安安静静地坐着，好像在坚持什么。这首诗是柳宗元被贬到永州时写的，大家认为老渔翁就是诗人自己：处境寒冷孤独，心里却不肯低头。有意思的是，四句的第一个字连起来是“千万孤独”，这可能是巧合，却正好说出了全诗的感觉。
analysisEn: This poem reads like an ink painting in black and white. The first two lines set the background: on a thousand mountains, not one bird is flying; on ten thousand paths, not one footprint. The world is huge, empty, frozen and silent. The last two lines add a figure: on the river, a small boat; in the boat, an old man in a straw raincoat and hat, fishing alone in the snow. “A thousand mountains” and “ten thousand paths” are vast; “a lone boat” and “fishing alone” are tiny. The contrast makes the old man look even lonelier — yet he is calm, sitting quietly as if holding on to something. Liu Zongyuan wrote this after being exiled to Yongzhou in the south, and readers have long seen the fisherman as the poet himself: in a cold, lonely place, but refusing to give in. A fun detail: the first characters of the four lines read 千万孤独, “utterly alone”. It may be a coincidence, but it sums up the poem perfectly.
background: Liu Zongyuan (773–819) was a leading writer of prose and poetry in the mid-Tang. After a failed political reform in 805 he was exiled to Yongzhou (in today’s Hunan) for ten years; this poem is thought to date from that time.
pronunciation: 蓑笠 suō lì；钓 diào。无其他特殊读音。
version: 采用通行的教材版本，各本基本无异文。

lines.lit: On a thousand mountains, birds’ flight has ended;
lines.en: Over a thousand hills, no bird in flight;

lines.lit: on ten thousand paths, human tracks have vanished.
lines.en: on ten thousand paths, no trace of man.

lines.lit: A lone boat, an old man in straw cape and hat,
lines.en: One boat — an old man in straw cape and hat

lines.lit: alone fishing the cold river snow.
lines.en: fishing alone in the snow on the cold river.

words.en: to be cut off; to be gone completely

words.note: 现代汉语多指“灭火”“消灭”，这里是“消失”。
舟：船（书面语）。现代汉语说“小船”。

words.en: straw rain cape and bamboo hat
words.note: 蓑：用草做的雨衣；笠：竹编的斗笠。今天已很少见。
现代汉语“老翁”“渔翁”，书面语。
钓：用鱼竿钓鱼，现代汉语“钓鱼”。

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 千山空空，没有一只鸟，写出天地的大和静。
imagery.en: A thousand empty mountains without a single bird show how vast and silent the world is.

imagery.name: 雪
imagery.zh: 大雪盖住一切，世界只剩一片白，冷而干净。
imagery.en: Snow covers everything; the world is reduced to white — cold and clean.

imagery.name: 孤舟
imagery.zh: 一条小船在大江上，是孤独的人，也是诗人自己的影子。
imagery.en: One small boat on a great river — the lonely man, and a reflection of the poet himself.

imagery.name: 江
imagery.zh: 寒冷的江面是老人坚持的地方：在最冷的地方，也不离开。
imagery.en: The freezing river is where the old man holds on — staying put in the coldest place.
